PAPERS.title: Residential indoor air monitoring to assess long-term exposure to air pollution in susceptible populations for epidemiology: overview and early findings.
PAPERS.pm: Indoor and matched outdoor PM2.5 plus 36 chemical components, RTI MicroPEM, 5-day runs in each of four seasons, hourly resolution
PAPERS.n: 130 older adults with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, Seoul Metropolitan Area, 2021-23. Indoor hourly PM2.5 averaged 14.90 ug/m3 (SD 36.12) against 20.44 (61.63) outdoors, higher in winter (20.17) than summer (11.19) and by day than night, with hourly patterns that contrast rather than track outdoors. Infiltration factors from median indoor/outdoor ratios of sulfur, nickel and iron were 51-70%. Source contrasts were large: pets 24.09 vs 13.35, humidifiers 19.19 vs 13.16, smokers 16.76 vs 11.79, cooking 15.14 vs 10.96 ug/m3. Standard deviations exceed every mean, so the distribution is episodic and a seasonal mean is a poor summary; five days per season is also thin support for a long-term exposure claim, and no health estimate is reported yet. The transferable piece for distributed sensing is the non-contact protocol - instruments redeployed by postal mail for repeat visits, which is how an unattended network is actually serviced at scale.

PAPERS.title: Cardiopulmonary hospitalization risks from wildfire-specific and non-wildfire PM2.5 in 20 US states.
PAPERS.pm: Two-year average wildfire-specific vs non-wildfire PM2.5, modelled and source-separated, per 1 ug/m3
PAPERS.n: Twenty US states, 2006-19, self-controlled. Per 1 ug/m3, wildfire-specific PM2.5 carried higher cardiopulmonary hospitalisation risk than non-wildfire PM2.5 across every outcome: 10% for heart failure to 16% for asthma, against 4.7% for COPD to 8.5% for hypertension. Associations were stronger among minorities, metropolitan residents, those with fewer years of education and more deprived communities. The toxicity contrast is the contribution - equal mass is not equal hazard, which undercuts the mass-only exposure metric every regulatory network and every low-cost sensor reports. Two limits matter. No confidence intervals are given in the abstract for any of the eight headline risks, so precision cannot be judged from the published summary. And wildfire-specific PM2.5 is itself a modelled quantity; the toxicity difference is therefore conditional on a smoke attribution step whose own error is not propagated into these estimates.

PAPERS.title: Role of low-level jet evolution in vertical aerosol redistribution: a Doppler wind lidar study over East China.
PAPERS.pm: Coherent Doppler wind lidar backscatter, spectral width and shear profiles against surface PM10
PAPERS.n: Two dust episodes over Hefei. In April 2021 the northwesterly low-level-jet core descended from 2.5 km to 0.3 km then re-ascended to 1.0 km while surface PM10 peaked at 410 ug/m3, accompanied by vertical wind shear above 0.04 s-1 and increased spectral width at the lower jet interface and a downward shift of the enhanced-backscatter layer. In March 2022 a stable jet core and persistent lower-tropospheric stability held aerosol aloft; the PM10 peak came at 16:00 LT, about 8 h after inferred frontal onset. Two redistribution regimes, then: rapid downward mixing during jet descent, versus delayed surface impact from a decoupled elevated layer. This is mechanism illustration from two cases, not climatology, and the inertial-oscillation attribution rests on hodograph rotation alone. It is also the cleanest statement of why a surface-only sensor network can read clean air for hours while a loaded layer sits directly overhead.

PAPERS.title: Short-term effects of ambient air pollution exposure on respiratory hospitalizations among children in the State of Mexico.
PAPERS.pm: Daily PM2.5, PM10, CO, NO2 and O3 from fixed monitoring stations; primary window lag 1-7 cumulative
PAPERS.n: 266 children under five hospitalised for respiratory disease at one regional IMSS hospital in the Toluca Valley Metropolitan Zone during 2023, analysed by matched case-crossover with conditional logistic regression adjusted for temperature and humidity. PM2.5 was associated with admission for viral pneumonia, bacterial pneumonia and asthma; CO with bronchiolitis; municipality-level associations were heterogeneous, concentrated in San Mateo Atenco, Metepec and Calimaya. The abstract reports direction only - not one odds ratio, confidence interval or unit appears anywhere - so the effect size is unverifiable from the published summary. 266 events split across four diagnoses, five pollutants, several lag windows and three municipalities is also thin, and exposure comes entirely from fixed stations with no personal or indoor component in a valley where indoor sources are likely to dominate a young child's dose.

PAPERS.journal: Int J Chron Obstruct Pulmon Dis
PAPERS.title: Residential Green and Blue Space, the Natural Environment, Genetic Susceptibility, and Incident COPD.
PAPERS.pm: Residential green space, blue space and natural environment at 300 m and 1000 m buffers; no PM term reported
PAPERS.n: 385,502 UK Biobank participants. At the 1000 m buffer, higher green space gave HR 0.87 (95% CI 0.83-0.92) and higher natural-environment exposure HR 0.83 (0.78-0.87) for incident COPD; blue space was weak and inconsistent. A COPD polygenic risk score did not modify either association on the multiplicative or the additive scale, and the natural-environment association held across every genetic stratum. The absence of gene-environment interaction argues the protective signal is not running through a genetically susceptible subgroup. The inferential problem is what is missing: no air-pollution term is reported. Residential greenness is inversely correlated with traffic PM2.5 and NO2 almost everywhere, so an unadjusted greenness-COPD association is a plausible restatement of a pollution-COPD association, and nothing in the abstract separates them.

PAPERS.title: Daily associations between outdoor air pollution and sleep quality.
PAPERS.pm: Daytime outdoor PM2.5, NO2 and O3 aggregated from city monitoring stations; same-day and previous-day
PAPERS.n: Budapest Sleep, Traits and Experiences Study: seven days per participant with daily activity and sleep-quality reports plus home EEG giving sleep efficiency, %REM, onset latency and total sleep time. Linear mixed models with a participant random intercept adjusted for age, sex, BMI, education, weekday, season, temperature, physical activity, screen exposure and travel. Day-1 ozone predicted lower day-2 sleep efficiency and poorer perceived quality, surviving multiple-comparison correction, multi-pollutant models and sensitivity analyses for depression, insomnia and chronotype. No robust day-to-night association emerged for PM2.5 or NO2 - a null worth recording. The result is however confounded with exposure-model quality: city-aggregated station data give near-zero within-city contrast, and misclassification is far worse for spatially heterogeneous PM2.5 than for ozone. The pollutant that survived is the one the exposure metric measures best. Sample size is not stated.

PAPERS.title: Exposure to cement industry emissions and respiratory health outcomes: a global systematic review and meta-analysis from 2000 to 2025.
PAPERS.pm: Cement dust and cement-plant emissions, occupational and residential; no harmonised gravimetric metric across studies
PAPERS.n: Eighteen observational studies published 2000-2025, registered as PROSPERO CRD420251268913. Random-effects pooling gave standardised mean differences of -0.71 for FEV1, -0.56 for FVC and -0.57 for FEV1/FVC in exposed groups; chronic cough was significantly more common, while other respiratory symptoms were elevated but not significant. Occupational exposure produced greater FEV1 impairment than residential exposure, which is the expected dose ordering and the most reassuring internal check available. Reporting is the weakness: no confidence interval, no I-squared and no prediction interval accompanies any pooled estimate in the abstract, so neither precision nor between-study heterogeneity can be assessed. SMDs pooled across studies using different spirometry reference equations and no common dust metric also cannot be read as a dose-response.

PAPERS.title: Continental pollutants modulate organic nitrogen and light absorption of marine organic aerosols over East Asian marginal seas.
PAPERS.pm: Shipboard aerosol organic nitrogen, water-soluble and water-insoluble fractions, ON/OC ratio and light absorption over three seasons
PAPERS.n: Shipboard sampling over the Yellow and Bohai Seas in spring, summer and autumn. Aerosol organic nitrogen averaged 0.35 +/- 0.25 ug N m-3, 4-60% of total nitrogen depending on season and highest in autumn. Anthropogenic secondary pollutants - aged biomass burning and secondary nitrate - supplied 36-76% of ON, 46-83% of the water-soluble and 39-89% of the water-insoluble fraction; in spring dust accounted for 55% of ON and above 80% during a dust episode, while summer carried a marine biogenic component. Organic-aerosol light absorption rose with both ON concentration and ON/OC ratio, so absorption capability per unit carbon increased with nitrogen enrichment rather than tracking mass. Three cruises give no annual coverage and the apportionment is receptor modelling on a small campaign. The sensing consequence is direct: an optical instrument calibrated on one absorption regime is misapplied when composition shifts under continental outflow.

PAPERS.title: Interpretable Spatiotemporal Coupling Network for Robust Emission Prediction and Implicit Mechanism Mining in Sludge Gasification.
PAPERS.pm: Continuous industrial stack monitoring of PM, SO2 and NOx from a sludge-gasification plant, with feature-level optimal time lags
PAPERS.n: PISTC-Net couples a directed process topology with per-feature optimal time lags. On industrial-scale data it reached R2 of 91.18% for SO2, 80.37% for NOx and 78.09% for PM. Under stress tests simulating abrupt sensor failure it continued to track emission trajectories by exploiting learned process inertia, and its hierarchical attention shifted from upstream thermochemical zones for SO2 to whole-process attention for PM, flagging disturbance propagation 5-8 minutes before emission peaks. PM is the worst-predicted of the three species, and that is the informative result: particle formation runs through nucleation, condensation and agglomeration paths that a topology-plus-lag representation captures least well, whereas gas-phase sulfur is nearly a mass balance. Single plant, no external validation site, and interpretability is inferred from attention maps, which are a saliency artefact rather than a causal readout. The sensor-failure robustness is the reusable part.

PAPERS.title: Urban Green Walls under Traffic Stress: Linking the Elemental Composition of Particulate Matter Deposition to Plant Physiological and Gene Expression Responses.
PAPERS.pm: Multi-elemental fractionation of PM deposited on green-wall foliage - insoluble, soluble and whole-leaf fractions - with SEM-EDS, over one year
PAPERS.n: A nine-species green wall at a high-traffic urban site, followed for a year. PCA on the insoluble fraction of Al, Cr, Cs, Fe, Mn, Mo, Rb, Sb, Sn, Ti and Zn identified Photinia x fraseri as the highest and most stable retainer of non-exhaust traffic particles and Pteris vittata as the lowest and least stable, with SEM-EDS showing up to 100-fold higher retention in the former. The methodological finding is the one that travels: only insoluble elements traced deposition reliably, because soluble and whole-leaf fractions are dominated by endogenous pools of nutrients and of tracers such as Cs and Rb, so conventional whole-leaf digestion overestimates deposition. Photinia showed marked seasonal physiological and transcriptional modulation; Pteris did not. One wall at one site, with no paired ambient PM mass measurement, so species are ranked against each other but no removal flux is quantified and no air-quality benefit can be inferred.

PAPERS.title: Evaluation of Ambient Air Particulate Matter, Urine Arsenic Levels and the Effect on Residents Health in an Artisanal Mining Community and an Incorporated Mining Community in Ghana.
PAPERS.pm: Ambient PM2.5 and PM10 by Modular Air Quality System; urinary arsenic by atomic absorption spectrophotometry
PAPERS.n: 65 residents each from an artisanal and an incorporated mining community in Ghana, all resident at least five years. PM2.5 in the artisanal community and PM10 in the incorporated community exceeded the thresholds the authors cite; more artisanal residents fell in the at-risk band for kidney disease by urinary albumin-creatinine ratio (p = 0.006), while the incorporated community showed poorer general health status. Several problems limit this to descriptive value. n = 130 total, analysis is chi-square on dichotomised uACR with no confounder adjustment and no exposure-response, and neither PM concentrations nor urinary arsenic levels are numerically reported in the abstract despite being the two measured exposures. The 35 and 70 ug/m3 figures quoted as WHO standards are the 2005-era interim targets, not the 2021 guideline values of 15 and 45 ug/m3 for 24-hour PM2.5 and PM10, so the exceedance framing understates how far these communities sit above guidance.

PAPERS.title: Integrative transcriptomic analysis identifies CCL22-associated immune signatures in air pollution-related atopic dermatitis.
PAPERS.pm: No measured PM; pollutant-associated gene sets taken from a toxicogenomic database and intersected with atopic-dermatitis transcriptomes
PAPERS.n: Shared pollutant-atopic dermatitis targets were enriched in cytokine and chemokine signalling, pattern-recognition receptor activity, IL-17 signalling and Toll-like receptor pathways. A framework over 15 algorithms and 175 combinations selected plsRglm + AdaBoost, reporting AUC 0.963 in training and 1.000, 0.909 and 0.966 in three validation cohorts, and yielding a ten-gene signature (CCL22, CCL5, CSF2, F2RL1, HRH4, ICAM1, IFNG, IL10, IL17A, IL18). CCL22 was upregulated in lesional samples, localised to dendritic cells and macrophages by single-cell data, and confirmed in DNFB-induced murine dermatitis. The exposure link is the weak joint: no particulate matter was measured or administered anywhere in the study, so air pollution enters only as a database annotation. An AUC of exactly 1.000 in a validation cohort indicates leakage or overfitting rather than performance, and DNFB is a contact hapten, not a particle. Hypothesis-generating only.

PAPERS.title: Beyond Blood and Urine: Decoding the Human Chemical Exposome across Matrices and Time.
PAPERS.pm: No measured PM; air positioned as one external matrix within a multi-matrix exposome design
PAPERS.n: A Perspective arguing that high-resolution mass spectrometry can now profile thousands of chemical features per sample while study design has not kept pace - no investigation has yet combined external source monitoring, multi-matrix internal biomonitoring and toxicokinetic normalisation inside one longitudinal framework. Three elements are proposed: multi-matrix sampling extending beyond blood and urine to accumulation archives, developmental matrices and external media; a Unified Exposure Scale placing heterogeneous matrices on a common toxicokinetically normalised dosimetric axis; and a two-track hazard-prioritisation pipeline for uncharacterised features. No data and no validation. The Unified Exposure Scale is also circular at the point it matters most, since it needs toxicokinetic parameters that do not exist for the molecular dark matter it is meant to rank. Logged for how air monitoring is being positioned inside the Global Human Exposome Project.

PAPERS.title: Exposure to airborne fine particulate matter disrupts human embryonic stem cell osteogenic differentiation.
PAPERS.pm: PM composition, dose and collection route not recoverable from metadata
PAPERS.n: Metadata only. BMC deposited this DOI on 18 September with no abstract, and Crossref, Europe PMC core, Europe PMC fullTextXML and the publisher landing page all returned nothing on per-DOI retry - the first time this issue's gap has appeared on a BMC rather than an Elsevier deposit. Carried on title because skeletal development is an endpoint the PM literature has barely touched and a human-embryonic-stem-cell osteogenic model would be a genuinely new mechanistic line rather than another airway or endothelial assay. No finding is asserted here: neither the particle source, the dose, the exposure duration nor the direction of the reported disruption is verifiable from metadata. On the retry list for a later issue.

PAPERS.title: Long-term (2008-2024) analysis of black carbon aerosols over a semi-arid rain-shadow region in southern peninsular India: trends, wavelet analysis, machine learning approaches and source regions.
PAPERS.pm: Black carbon, presumably aethalometer-derived; instrument, wavelength set and trend magnitudes not recoverable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only; the expected same-day Elsevier deposit gap, with no abstract in Crossref, Europe PMC or PubMed on per-DOI retry. Carried on title because a 17-year single-site black-carbon record in a semi-arid rain-shadow setting is exactly the kind of long baseline that trend detection needs and that South Asian networks mostly lack, and because absorption-coefficient records are what constrain the optical-to-mass conversion every filter- and scattering-based instrument depends on. No trend, no magnitude and no source attribution is asserted here; the title names the methods, not the results. On the retry list.

PAPERS.title: Selective real-time monitoring of respiratory droplets for indoor air safety in educational environments.
PAPERS.pm: Respiratory-droplet detection; sensing principle, size range and selectivity mechanism not recoverable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - Elsevier same-day deposit, abstract absent from Crossref, Europe PMC and PubMed on per-DOI retry. Retained because selective real-time discrimination of respiratory droplets against a background of ambient particles is the hard problem for any optical counter deployed indoors: a scattering sensor reports total number in a size bin and cannot by itself tell exhaled aerosol from resuspended dust, so any claimed selectivity mechanism is worth reading. Whether that selectivity is optical, chemical or inferential is not recoverable from the title, and no performance claim is asserted. On the retry list.

PAPERS.title: Beyond Inhalation: Air as an Integrative Matrix for Exposome Research.
PAPERS.pm: No measured PM; air framed as an exposome sampling matrix
PAPERS.n: Metadata only. ACS deposited this DOI on 18 September without an abstract and no text was recoverable from Crossref, Europe PMC or PubMed on per-DOI retry. Carried because it is the second air-as-exposome-matrix Perspective in this same issue, alongside Sunyer-Caldu, which makes the pair an editorial signal rather than a coincidence: air sampling is being argued into the exposome programme as an integrative matrix rather than merely an inhalation route. No argument or claim is asserted here beyond what the title states. On the retry list.

PAPERS.title: Effects of fine particulate matter on neuroblastoma cell line: metabolic and lipid deregulations and their consequences on the onset of neurological diseases.
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5, in vitro dosing; no harmonised mass concentration or duration reported
PAPERS.n: Narrative review built around the SH-SY5Y human neuroblastoma line as an in vitro neurodegeneration model. The proposed cascade runs mitochondrial damage to ER stress to oxidative stress to calcium dyshomeostasis to lipid dysregulation, converging on apoptosis and autophagy-dependent ferroptosis, with lipid peroxidation advanced as the emerging driver. No pooled estimate, no exposure-response and no dose metric: the review does not harmonise PM2.5 mass, source or exposure duration across the studies it assembles, and the in vitro doses it draws on generally sit far above ambient, so the chain is qualitative. It also concedes the in vitro-to-human translation gap it is built on. For distributed sensing the implication is specific - every mechanism it privileges is composition-dependent (redox-active metals, organic carbon), which a mass-only network cannot resolve.

PAPERS.title: Beta-carotene alleviates PM2.5-induced pulmonary fibrosis via suppression of the Frizzled5-mediated Wnt5a/Ca2+ pathway.
PAPERS.design: Animal exposure study + in vitro receptor overexpression
PAPERS.pm: Intratracheal PM2.5 instillation; dose, source and treatment concentration not reported
PAPERS.n: C57BL/6 mice given intratracheal PM2.5, paired with BEAS-2B human bronchial epithelial cells carrying Fzd5 overexpression. Instillation produced fibrosis, oxidative stress and calcium dyshomeostasis - more mitochondria-associated ER membranes, altered IP3R, STIM1, ORAI1 and SERCA2 - with activation of a Wnt5a/Fzd5/Ca2+ axis. Dietary beta-carotene reversed these changes, and Fzd5 overexpression abolished the protection, identifying Fzd5 as the mediating receptor. No instilled dose, particle source, treatment concentration, effect size or CI is reported for any endpoint, so potency cannot be placed against ambient exposure. Intratracheal instillation also bypasses the deposition physics a sensor-derived exposure metric is meant to approximate.

PAPERS.title: Investigations of black carbon aerosol sources and strengths over a rural-valley location in Haryana, India.
PAPERS.pm: Equivalent black carbon, seven-wavelength AE33, 880 nm; annual and seasonal means in ug/m3
PAPERS.n: Three years of seven-wavelength AE33 aethalometer measurements (January 2020 to December 2022) at Panchgaon, a rural Aravali valley site at 285 m AMSL in northwest India. Annual means: eBC 4.06 +/- 2.15 ug/m3, fossil-fuel eBCff 3.10 +/- 2.40 ug/m3, biomass-burning eBCbb 1.42 +/- 1.19 ug/m3, with eBCff carrying 68% of absorption at 880 nm. Winter maxima (eBCff 4.19, eBCbb 2.51 ug/m3) and monsoon minima (1.90, 0.52 ug/m3) track boundary-layer height and wet scavenging. The aethalometer-model split rests on assumed absorption Angstrom exponents that are never reported, and the eBCff/eBCbb ratio of 3.02 +/- 3.80 has a standard deviation larger than its mean - the apportionment is unstable. A three-year reference-grade absorption record at a rural South Asian site is exactly the co-location anchor low-cost networks there lack.

PAPERS.title: Ambient Carbon Monoxide as a Delayed Trigger of Acute Aortic Dissection: A Time-Stratified Case-Crossover Study in a Tropical Industrial Metropolis.
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5, PM10, CO, NO2, O3, SO2 from 24 fixed stations; lags 0-3 d, per 1 ppm and per IQR
PAPERS.n: Time-stratified case-crossover of 798 emergency-department-confirmed acute aortic dissections, 2018-2021, exposures assigned from 24 monitoring stations, conditional logistic regression across lags 0-3 adjusted for meteorology. No pollutant was associated on the event day. At 2-day lag each 1 ppm CO increment carried a 2.67-fold risk (95% CI 1.207-5.900) and each IQR increment of 0.19 ppm raised risk 113% (95% CI 1.075-4.239); PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3 and SO2 showed nothing at any lag. Two problems: a 1 ppm contrast is roughly five IQRs, so the headline number extrapolates past the observed range, and with six pollutants across four lags the one surviving association is not multiplicity-corrected. Relevant negatively - station-assigned PM at this network density returned nulls a denser deployment might resolve.

PAPERS.title: Outdoor Air Pollution, Perivascular Space Morphology, and Cognition in Preadolescence.
PAPERS.design: Cross-sectional cohort imaging + weighted quantile sum regression
PAPERS.pm: Annual-average PM2.5, O3, NO2 and 15 PM2.5 components, spatiotemporal models at residence
PAPERS.n: Cross-sectional analysis of 6,949 nine- to ten-year-olds in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study. Perivascular space (PVS) count and volume came from T1- and T2-weighted MRI, cognition from NIH Toolbox. Zinc, ammonium and bromine were positively associated with regional PVS count; higher count in five regions tracked poorer cognition; calcium, Zn and NH4+ were associated with poorer cognition (FDR-corrected p < 0.01); frontal-lobe PVS count mediated the Zn-total-cognition association (p < 0.01); and weighted quantile sum PM2.5 mixtures predicted higher temporal and cingulate PVS with poorer working memory and crystallised intelligence. Cross-sectional design cannot order exposure, PVS and cognition, and no effect sizes are reported - only significance. The component-specific pattern is the point for sensing: speciation, not mass, carries the signal.

PAPERS.title: Pollutants regulate changes in pathological markers of neurodegenerative diseases: a new perspective in environmental toxicology.
PAPERS.pm: Air pollutants treated as one class alongside metals and POPs; no exposure metric
PAPERS.n: Review organised around core neurodegenerative pathological markers - amyloid-beta, tau, alpha-synuclein, TDP-43 - rather than around individual pollutants, detailing how air pollutants, metals and persistent organic pollutants modulate the generation, aggregation, propagation and toxicity of each, under a proposed pollutants-pathogenic links-neural network failure framework. No quantitative synthesis, no effect estimates, no exposure metric and no study-quality appraisal; it reorganises existing mechanistic claims rather than adding evidence, and air pollutants are treated as a single undifferentiated class. The one useful implication for measurement is that marker-level convergence makes pollutant class, not PM mass, the exposure variable worth resolving.

PAPERS.title: Nonlinear Nitrate Formation Governed by Aerosol Water and VOC-Sensitive Oxidation in a Humid Urban Basin.
PAPERS.design: Field observations + box model + thermodynamic equilibrium
PAPERS.pm: Wintertime PM2.5 composition, NO2, Ox and aerosol liquid water content
PAPERS.n: Wintertime field observations in a humid, topographically confined Chinese urban basin, combined with a box model and thermodynamic calculations. Nitrate became the dominant PM2.5 component during pollution episodes, co-varying with NO2, Ox and aerosol liquid water content (ALWC). Pathway-resolved modelling split formation almost evenly between daytime OH+NO2 (52%) and nighttime heterogeneous N2O5 hydrolysis (46%), the latter rising sharply during episodes. Binning regressions located thresholds at RH 87% and ALWC 76.5 ug/m3 above which formation efficiency rose abruptly; VOCs exerted slightly stronger control than NOx, with oxygenated VOCs and alkenes dominant. One site, one winter, one box model - the thresholds are not validated out of sample. The RH threshold is directly load-bearing for sensor correction: it is the same humidity range where optical LCS bias diverges.

PAPERS.title: Unveiling the Importance of Organic Hydroxy Acids-Related Autoxidation Pathway in Isoprene Secondary Organic Aerosol Formation.
PAPERS.design: Year-long regional tracer measurements + box model
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5-phase isoprene SOA tracers, six iHOM species, ng/m3, nine sites
PAPERS.n: Year-long PM2.5 measurements at nine Pearl River Delta sites quantifying six isoprene-derived highly oxygenated molecules (iHOMs). Annual mean 2.69 +/- 3.52 ng/m3, higher in summer and autumn, dominated by methyltartaric acids (71%). Particle-phase tracer shares for the HOM, HMML and IEPOX pathways were 10%, 11% and 79%; box-modelled gas-phase intermediates gave 25%, 22% and 53%, so IEPOX dominates isoprene SOA in the polluted PRD with the other two non-negligible in winter. Pathway partitioning tracked the ISOPO2 isomer split - the HOM route from delta-ISOPO2 (6.5 +/- 3.0%), IEPOX and HMML from beta-ISOPO2. The standard deviation exceeds the mean, so the annual average describes episodes rather than a typical day, and tracer-to-SOA scaling relies on chamber yields measured well above ambient. These are nanogram-level organics - the composition layer no optical network sees.

PAPERS.title: Source apportionment of volatile organic compounds in a Philadelphia fenceline community: results from THRIVEair.
PAPERS.design: Community passive-sampler campaign + PMF source apportionment
PAPERS.pm: 38 VOCs, one-week integrated passive thermal-desorption tubes, 20 sites, 12 months
PAPERS.n: Year-long community-designed VOC campaign in South Philadelphia run with Philly Thrive, collecting one-week integrated passive thermal-desorption samples of 38 VOCs at 20 sites from July 2023 to June 2024 around a former oil refinery under redevelopment. Concentrations were higher in industrial than non-industrial and high- than low-traffic areas. Benzene, the community's declared concern, was low overall (median 1.21 ug/m3, range 0.31-9.05), while (m,p)-xylenes emerged as the industrial-area pollutant of concern; toluene:benzene and xylene:ethylbenzene ratios were higher at industrial and high-traffic sites, indicating fresher emissions, and PMF apportioned sources. One-week integration resolves none of the short plumes fenceline residents actually report. The design is the template distributed PM networks should copy: community-set siting and a declared pollutant of concern rather than compliance checking.

PAPERS.title: Tire Wear Pollution and Cardiovascular Risk.
PAPERS.pm: Tire-wear (non-exhaust) particles; no exposure metric retrievable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only (no abstract). Elsevier deposited title and authorship on 18 September with nothing in Crossref, Europe PMC core, Europe PMC fullTextXML or the OpenAlex per-work record. The title places it as a commentary linking tire-wear particle pollution to cardiovascular risk. Logged because the class matters for measurement: non-exhaust emissions now dominate traffic PM in fleets with modern aftertreatment, and tire wear differs from combustion PM in both size distribution and composition - a combination that mass-only optical sensors and exhaust-derived emission factors each mis-handle. Carried forward for pickup when the abstract appears.

PAPERS.title: Seasonal Variation in Volatile Organic Compound Emissions and Secondary Organic Aerosol Formation from Unconventional Oil and Gas Development.
PAPERS.pm: VOC emissions and SOA formation potential; no quantities retrievable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only (no abstract). Same-day Elsevier deposit; nothing in Crossref, Europe PMC core, Europe PMC fullTextXML or the OpenAlex per-work record. Title indicates a seasonally resolved measurement campaign of VOC emissions from unconventional oil and gas development and the secondary organic aerosol those emissions form. In scope as a PM precursor study: SOA is the fraction of basin PM2.5 that no emission inventory of primary particles captures, and seasonality in the precursor flux propagates straight into any exposure model built on annual-average emission factors. Carried forward for pickup.

PAPERS.title: Volatile organic compounds in Chengdu: Functional zone disparities and four-year dynamics in a basin city of Southwest China.
PAPERS.pm: Ambient VOCs by functional zone, four-year record; no quantities retrievable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only (no abstract). Same-day Elsevier deposit; no abstract in Crossref, Europe PMC core, Europe PMC fullTextXML or the OpenAlex per-work record. Title indicates a four-year ambient VOC record for Chengdu resolved by urban functional zone, in the same Sichuan Basin whose humidity-driven nitrate chemistry the Sun et al. record in this issue models. In scope as precursor monitoring: functional-zone contrasts are the spatial scale distributed networks are built to resolve, and a four-year baseline is long enough to separate trend from meteorological variability. Carried forward for pickup.

PAPERS.title: Characterizing layout-dependent breathing-zone contaminant concentration in office spaces with mixing ventilation using an occupant-to-exhaust distance metric.
PAPERS.pm: Breathing-zone contaminant concentration under mixing ventilation; no quantities retrievable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only (no abstract). Same-day Elsevier deposit; nothing in Crossref, Europe PMC core, Europe PMC fullTextXML or the OpenAlex per-work record. Title indicates a modelling study deriving breathing-zone contaminant concentration in mixing-ventilated offices from an occupant-to-exhaust distance metric. In scope for sensor siting specifically: it is a claim that indoor concentration is a predictable function of geometry, which is the assumption every single-point indoor monitor makes implicitly and almost never tests. Carried forward for pickup.
